caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a slightly curved lid, shown in perspective against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects. The chest is bordered and cornered with a tan or beige frame, and its surfaces are decorated with a swirling, intricate floral pattern in blue, yellow, green, and pink brushstrokes. The front and side panels prominently feature large pink flowers and blue fields, while the lid displays abstract swirls of blue, yellow, and green. A metallic clasp in a grayish tone is located on the front of the chest, rendered with simple lines and suggesting a lock mechanism. The image is centered, and the chest is the only object in the composition.
title: Box
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
